exposure: Body mass index (BMI) before index pregnancy
Excessive weight gain during index pregnancy
outcome: Neonatal transfer to intensive care unit
cohort: 159 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and a subsequent pregnancy, compared to 318 age-matched women without GDM as controls
finding: A positive family history of diabetes mellitus and a BMI ≥ 25 kg/m(2) before the subsequent pregnancy were strongly associated with GDM recurrence.
mod_finding: Delivery by caesarean section in the index pregnancy was of borderline significance for GDM recurrence (OR 2.2 [95% CI 0.9-5.2], p = 0.069).
